.claude/docs/gotchas.md: - For architectural decisions and their rationale, see `.andromeda/architecture.md` Established Decisions section

.claude/docs/services/viola-ui.md: None: the `viola_ui` log target in `src/obs.rs`, the reserved `ui` process value and its events in `viola-core` and `schemas/`, and the browser test leg have left the tree.
.claude/docs/workflow.md: This project uses a **reference-based** CLAUDE.md architecture — a thin CLAUDE.md index with deeper content in `.claude/docs/` (on-demand) and `.claude/rules/` (path-scoped). See `section-markers.md` in the Andromeda skills for the ownership convention between generated and user-curated sections.

.claude/rules/events.md: - 2026-10-16: A snapshot field that a reader expects once an event line is visible is written before that line is appended, never after: a reader that waits on the line and then reads the snapshot races a write made after it (the snapshot's `agent_session_id` and the `session-start` line).

.claude/rules/frontend.md: _This section is owned by `/wrap-session`. setup-project preserves content added here on re-run._

.claude/docs/commands.md: - `scripts/agent-run.sh logs --instance <name> | jq -c 'select(.record.level=="ERROR")'` — errors for one instance

.claude/rules/security.md: _This section is owned by `/wrap-session`. setup-project preserves content added here on re-run. See `section-markers.md` for the convention._

.claude/rules/ci.md: - 2026-10-13: A CI job that reads `cancelled` with no steps and no runner name never ran: read its cause from the check run's annotations (`gh api …/check-runs/<job id>/annotations`, e.g. "not acquired by Runner of type hosted"), since its log download answers 404, and re-run only that job (`gh run rerun <run> --failed`) to measure the leg.

.claude/rules/testing.md: - 2026-10-17: A new test binary's nextest layer is proven by the layers' own selection counts (`run --e2e`, and `run --integration --filter 'binary(<stem>)'` reading `nextest-exit-4`), never read off its stem: a numbered `path1_` stem reads as E2E-prefixed by eye yet missed the `^(path|…)_` regex and ran as an integration test.
.claude/rules/verification-harness.md: - 2026-10-14: A side effect added to a fake-agent turn (a spawned command, a replayed hook) goes after that turn's screen write, never between its Stop and the screen it draws: while it runs the earlier input box stays on screen, and a gate wait on a slower runner reads it as settled and types too early.

.claude/rules/observability.md: - 2026-09-24: `obs_event!` expands to `::tracing::event!`, so a raw-log census greps `tracing::(info|warn|error|debug|trace)!` — a bare `tracing::` grep reads the sanctioned macro in `viola_core::obs` as a raw call.
